segments.text: Welcome to the Northline Broadband 2024 support review. We will cover ticket volume, retention, network reliability, and how the team grew.
Ticket volume reached a record twenty-seven thousand in the fourth quarter, driven by the regional pricing change and storm damage, up from twelve thousand in the first quarter.
Monthly churn spiked to six point two percent in March because of a billing bug that double-charged a cohort, then improved to three point nine percent in April after the onboarding rewrite.

On reliability, Coast ninety-fifth percentile latency reached two hundred and forty milliseconds, the worst of any region, which repeatedly paged the on-call engineer. A regional cache brought it back to target.
Finally, the support organisation grew to a hundred and five people, with field engineering the largest team at forty-five.
